question: Which festival is celebrated in honour of Lord Padmasambhava?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hemis Festival.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemis Festival** is a** two-day festival** celebrated in the Hemis Monastery in** Ladakh, India.**
 
• The festival is celebrated in honor of **Guru Padmasambhava,** who is believed to have founded Tibetan Buddhism.
 
• During the festival, the locals wear traditional costumes and perform the **Cham dance**, a masked dance that depicts various episodes from the life of Guru Padmasambhava.
 
• The Hemis Festival is also a popular** tourist attraction** and is attended by people from all over the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hornbill Festival** is a popular festival celebrated in **Nagaland, India.**

 
 
• The festival is celebrated in honor of the** Hornbill bird**, which is considered sacred by the locals.
 
• The festival is a celebration of the **rich cultural heritage** of Nagaland and is attended by people from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Saga Dawa Festival **is a Buddhist festival celebrated in** Tibet, India, and Nepal**.
 
 
• The festival is celebrated in honor of the birth, enlightenment, and death of **Lord Buddha.**
 
• During the festival, the locals perform various religious** rituals and ceremonies.**
 
 
 
• **Gangaur Festival** is a popular festival celebrated in** Rajasthan, India.**
 
 
• The festival is celebrated in honor of** Goddess Gauri, **who is believed to bring good luck and prosperity.
 
• During the festival, the women dress up in** traditional attire** and offer prayers to the goddess.
